type DescribeConstrained<T> = T extends infer U extends string ? 'str' : 'not';
const numericDescription: DescribeConstrained<number> = 'not';
const stringDescription: DescribeConstrained<string> = 'str';
type ConstrainedAlias = 1 | 2;
type AliasDescription = ConstrainedAlias extends infer U extends 1 ? 'one' : 'other';
const aliasDescription: AliasDescription = 'other';
type DistributedConstraint<T> = T extends infer U extends string ? U : never;
const distributed: DistributedConstraint<'word' | 3> = 'word';
type WholeConstraint<T> = [T] extends [infer U extends string] ? U : 'fallback';
const whole: WholeConstraint<string | number> = 'fallback';
type TupleConstraint<T, C> = T extends [infer U extends C, infer V extends C] ? [U, V] : 'fallback';
const matchingTuple: TupleConstraint<['a', 'b'], string> = ['a', 'b'];
const differentTuple: TupleConstraint<[1, 'b'], string> = 'fallback';
const numericTuple: TupleConstraint<[1, 2], number> = [1, 2];
type RestConstraint<T, C> = T extends [...infer U extends C[], number] ? U : 'fallback';
const matchingRest: RestConstraint<['a', 'b', 1], string> = ['a', 'b'];
const differentRest: RestConstraint<['a', true, 1], string> = 'fallback';
type UnconstrainedConditional<T> = T extends infer U ? U : never;
const unconstrained: UnconstrainedConditional<1 | 'word'> = 1;
console.log(numericDescription, stringDescription, aliasDescription, distributed, whole);
console.log(matchingTuple, differentTuple, numericTuple, matchingRest, differentRest, unconstrained);
